description: Store a secret, such as an API key, as an encrypted Vault record. Tools never return the saved value.

alias.description: Secret name: A-Z, 0-9, underscore; starts with a letter. Example: OPENAI_API_KEY

content.description: Secret value for single type, or JSON string for bundle type.

secretType.description: "single" (one key-value pair), "bundle" (JSON object of key-value pairs), or "json" (one JSON document sealed whole, for structured config like an executor descriptor). Default: single.

walletAddress.description: Owner wallet address (EVM 0x... or DID). Omit when signed in to use the current account.

name: proofable_secret_create
